name: ISG15 conjugation and interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors
rationale: All members concern effector actions of interferon-stimulated genes, chiefly ISG15 conjugation, whereas confusables cover upstream RIG-I/IRF3 sensing and interferon induction or broad IFN response signatures.

name: Immunosuppressive IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10 production/signaling, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling and suppression of IL-12 production, distinguishing it from confusables built on IL-12/IL-23/IL-17 or C-type lectin antifungal signaling.

name: Aldosterone response and negative regulation of sodium import
rationale: Members concern aldosterone response and restraint of sodium import/transport in the kidney, unlike confusables centred on calcium/potassium transport, positive sodium transport, or angiotensin and blood-pressure control.

core: Bile acid synthesis and enterohepatic transport
name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic transport and intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis routes, recycling, transporter defects (ABCB11, ABCB4, ABCG5/8) and intestinal lipid/cholesterol absorption, unlike confusables on xenobiotic/organic anion transport, lipoproteins or dietary lipid digestion.

name: Fibroblast fate and TGF-beta1 production in fibrotic matrix remodeling
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and apoptosis, TGF-beta1 production, matrix assembly/disassembly and connective tissue replacement, whereas confusables emphasise SMAD signaling, collagen metabolism or fibroblast migration.

qualifier: snRNP cap hypermethylation and decapping decay
name: RNA 5' cap formation, snRNP maturation and decapping decay
rationale: Members span mRNA capping, snRNA cap hypermethylation, snRNP assembly/transport and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay, distinguishing it from confusables focused on polyadenylation, histone mRNA processing, rRNA or deadenylation-dependent decay.

name: Regulation of adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and aldosterone secretion
rationale: Members regulate cortisol and mineralocorticoid/aldosterone biosynthesis and secretion, unlike confusables listing steroidogenic enzyme defects, cortisol/HPA responses or renal aldosterone effects.

name: Renin-angiotensin signaling raising blood volume and arterial pressure
rationale: Members are angiotensin signaling and renin-angiotensin control of renal resistance, blood volume and increased arterial pressure, unlike confusables on vascular smooth muscle tone, natriuretic cGMP signaling or aldosterone sodium handling.

name: Nucleoside triphosphate sanitization and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members combine NUDT-mediated (d)NTP hydrolysis for DNA protection with thiopurine (TPMT, azathioprine), ribavirin and abacavir metabolism, unlike confusables on pyrimidine catabolism, purine de novo synthesis or purine salvage.

name: Inhibitory synapse assembly, GABA receptor clustering and transmission
rationale: Members cover gephyrin/GABA receptor clustering, inhibitory synapse assembly and inhibitory potentials with presynaptic release, distinguishing it from confusables on excitatory NMDA/PSD-95 synapses or presynaptic GABA-B/G-protein effects.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ and AP-2 transcriptional control of growth
rationale: Most members are Hippo signaling, cell-density sensing and YAP1/TAZ transcription, joined by AP-2 factor regulation, which separates it from confusables adding TGF-beta cancer mutants, senescence, PTK6 or anoikis.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar transport, glycolipid and GPI anchor
name: Nucleotide-sugar transport, glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor biosynthesis
rationale: Members are SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, GDP-fucose/UDP-glucuronate synthesis, glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor synthesis, unlike confusables centred on N-glycan, dolichol, UDP-GlcNAc or sialic acid metabolism.

qualifier: mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative cell death
name: Oxidative stress cell death and mitochondrial respiration regulation
rationale: Members regulate peroxide/hypoxia-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis plus mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis, unlike confusables centred on nitric oxide responses, PGC-1alpha or ROS detoxification enzymes.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and polyol with inherited defects
name: Galactose, fructose and polyol catabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose and fructose catabolism, their enzyme deficiencies and alditol metabolism, unlike confusables on pentose/xylulose or glycerol metabolism.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein lipolytic remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members are chylomicron/VLDL remodeling by LPL/LIPC and clearance, unlike confusables on triglyceride catabolism generally, LDL receptor endocytosis, intestinal chylomicron assembly or HDL/LDL remodeling.

name: Intracellular bacterial entry, phagosome maturation and its subversion
rationale: Members cover Listeria and Mycobacterium entry, phagosome acidification/lysosome fusion and xenophagy, and their blockade by the pathogen, unlike confusables on toxins, SARS or neutrophil antimicrobial granules.

name: PPARG-driven white adipocyte differentiation
rationale: All members concern PPARG-regulated white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development, unlike confusables on PPARA, LXR or circadian metabolic gene regulation.

qualifier: C-type lectin sensing with IL-17, IL-18, IL-36
name: Antifungal C-type lectin and IL-17/IL-18/IL-36 inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members are Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal sensing with IL-17/Th17, IL-18, IL-36/IL-38 and IL-23/GM-CSF production, distinguishing it from confusables on IL-1 processing, IL-10/IL-12/IL-27 or type III interferon.

name: Nuclear envelope-lamina dynamics and ILK-integrin cytoskeletal adhesion
rationale: Members join nuclear envelope/lamina disassembly, reassembly and positioning with PINCH-ILK-parvin integrin adhesion, unlike confusables on ESCRT sealing and cytokinesis or nuclear pore complex assembly.

name: Motile cilium dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance
rationale: Members are axonemal dynein arm assembly, motile cilium assembly and mucociliary clearance, unlike confusables on sperm flagella or multiciliogenesis and CSF flow.

qualifier: oncogenic fusions and amplifications to AKT and ERK
name: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions activating AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK and LTK fusion/amplification signaling with PI3K-AKT and ERK activation, unlike confusables on ligand-specific FGFR/ERBB/MET cascades, IGF1R/insulin or drug-resistant mutants.

name: Mitotic spindle assembly, checkpoint and midzone-driven cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover spindle formation, kinetochore attachment and checkpoint, midzone assembly and cytokinesis, unlike confusables on contractile ring, APC/C transition or sister chromatid cohesion and condensation.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and ROS generation
rationale: Members regulate respiratory burst, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production by phagocyte NADPH oxidase, unlike confusables on neutrophil degranulation, Fc receptor signaling or anti-inflammatory macrophage responses.

name: Insulin receptor PI3K-AKT signaling, glycogen control and signal attenuation
rationale: Members are IRS/IGF1R-AKT activation, glycogen synthesis regulation and negative regulation of insulin response and glucose import, unlike confusables on oncogenic RTKs or GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin.

qualifier: pyrophosphates, nuclear phosphoinositides and PTEN regulation
name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and PTEN regulation
rationale: Members cover inositol and diadenosine pyrophosphate metabolism, nuclear PIP/IP synthesis and PTEN localization and stability, unlike confusables on AKT targets, PTEN loss in cancer or ceRNA control of PTEN.
